infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Alibi Protocol needs camera access to record video evidence during police encounters.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Alibi Protocol needs microphone access to record audio evidence during police encounters.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Alibi Protocol uses your location for navigation, DePIN earning, and evidence geolocation.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Alibi Protocol uses your location for continuous navigation and DePIN earning while driving.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Alibi Protocol uses background location for DePIN earning during active navigation sessions.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Alibi Protocol to access your microphone for audio evidence.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Alibi Protocol to access your location for navigation and DePIN earning.
